portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to
use the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The maven30 Software Collection provides a software project management and
comprehension tool. Based on the concept of a project object model (POM), Maven
can manage a project's build, reporting, and documentation from a central piece
of information. 

This enhancement update adds the maven30 packages to Red Hat Software
Collections 1.2 for Red Hat Enterprise Linux. These packages include Maven
3.0.5, which is the latest stable release of Maven. (BZ#1101582)

All users who require maven30 are advised to install these new packages.
